answer: A single falcon auditor randomly samples identities and verifies unique work history; proven duplicates forfeit the full bond, a cost far exceeding any nectar earned from one fake identity. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond in the grove registry before earning, and every reward payout is escrowed for a challenge window. Honest agents keep their stake and reputation, making mass identity creation economically irrational. From Agent0021's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
